style: Simple black-and-white webcomic doodle, drawn with a thick black felt marker on plain white paper. Slightly wobbly hand-drawn outlines, all the same thickness. Hair and dark clothes are solid pure-black shapes; a few flat light-grey areas for shadows. Characters: oversized round head on a small stubby body, huge round white eyes with small black dot pupils, expressive eyebrows, tiny simple mouth, scruffy spiky hair, floppy noodle arms, mitten hands, pink blush marks on the cheeks. Exaggerated body language, small sweat drops and motion lines. White background left almost empty: one floor or desk line and one or two simple props. Flat colours only, one small accent colour at most.
style_with_ref: Draw it in exactly the same drawing style as image 0: same marker line weight, same solid black fills, same huge round eyes and oversized heads, same nearly empty white background. Do not copy the characters or the scene of image 0.
constraints: One single full-bleed illustration, edge to edge, no panel borders. Wordless picture: no text, no lettering, no speech bubbles; any sign, board or screen is blank. The top quarter of the picture is empty white background.
